selected.baseline_existing: Pale flowering branches on the shutter frame.
selected.new_literal_implementation: One continuous, mostly leafless brown branch is anchored to the shutter's upper frame, bearing small ivory flowers at distinct nodes with bare woody intervals between them; this sparse contour lets the golden seam remain visible.

selected.baseline_existing: Broad soft frontal fill, warm light grazing bob and lace.
selected.new_literal_implementation: Soft neutral-cool fill keeps the central forehead, nose and cheeks pale and cool-toned; only the seam-facing cheek rim, jaw edge and ear take a restrained warm reflection from the gilt leaf, so the two illumination zones remain visibly separate.
all_components: Warm source-facing skin contour limited to an edge region

excluded_from_data_causal_improvement: reference short bob and facial cues

unselected_visual_profiles.contained_affect_self_presentation: Controlled social presentation, an affect leak and an interrupted self-regulation gesture would add a different psychological event; quiet technical attention already makes the scene particular.
unselected_visual_profiles.diegetic_reality_invariant_failure: The declared world-invariant failure would replace the physically ordinary pulley and light mechanism with an uncanny rule; it does not serve this scene.
unselected_visual_profiles.embodied_corruption_transition: An unfinished bodily corruption state would move the central impression away from serene rehearsal stillness toward an incompatible transition.
unselected_visual_profiles.hourglass_silhouette_relation: A new silhouette study would shift attention from the face and mechanism; the reference supplies no body evidence and the chosen medium view is not a useful comparison.
unselected_visual_profiles.kuudere_composed_warmth_relation: The complete relation requires a trusted counterpart and a benefit for that same counterpart, while this scene has a single operator working on a shutter.
unselected_visual_profiles.rectangle_silhouette_relation: A torso-width comparison would add an unrelated body emphasis and has no support from the appearance-only reference; retain the ordinary fictional stance.
unselected_visual_profiles.sheer_garment_optical_layering: Compatible with the lace wardrobe but not preferred: the full five-field optical study would compete with the simple human-mechanism relationship. Retain naturally readable lace without opting into a separate material gate set.
unselected_visual_profiles.uncanny_coherence_mismatch: A localized realism mismatch would introduce unease as a primary scene reading rather than quiet ethereal photographic coherence.

causal_boundary: A single final render can show survival of newly authored adopted components. It does not compare an image without data and cannot establish artistic improvement or user preference.
